name: ForgePad
description: The coin of ForgePad, the launchpad on Robinhood Chain. 1B fixed supply, no team allocation, no taxes, no owner — 800M sold on ForgePad's own bonding curve, 200M locked forever in the Uniswap v4 pool at graduation. FORGE receives 10% of every coin's trading fees and half of every swap and launch fee: part of it buys FORGE and burns it, the rest is paid to FORGE stakers. The fee split is a constant in the contracts; nobody can change it.
